brief:
A Palestinian baby died of hypothermia overnight in a family tent in southern Gaza, the child's father said, according to Al Jazeera English. The death occurred amid Israeli restrictions limiting the delivery of humanitarian assistance to the enclave.

The infant was sheltering in a tent in southern Gaza when the fatal exposure occurred. Displaced Palestinians are living in makeshift shelters as winter conditions persist in the territory.
dek: The baby's father said he died of hypothermia overnight in their family's tent in southern Gaza.
title: Palestinian baby dies of cold in Gaza tent amid aid restrictions
